Remark
[Symmetric systems generalize second-order hyperbolic PDE] ↗ def:symmetric-strictly-hyperbolic-system ↗ def:uniform-hyperbolicity 1. ch7:7.3.2-rem-1\group Hyperbolic Systems

A system \[ B_0\mathbf u_t+\sum _{j=1}^nB_j\mathbf u_{x_j}=\mathbf f \tag {9} \] is symmetric when every $B_j$ is symmetric and $B_0$ is positive definite. The scalar equation \[ v_{tt}-\sum _{i,j=1}^na^{ij}v_{x_ix_j}=0 \tag {10} \] has this form for $\mathbf u=(v_{x_1},\ldots ,v_{x_n},v_t)$, with $B_0$ positive definite by uniform hyperbolicity.
